judge-calibration.note: Registry home of the two floors a model-judge calibration record must clear to read earned (LIFEOS/TOOLS/lib/Calibration.ts calibrationFloors, moved out of code 2026-10-12): `agreement` is the share of the principal's labels the judge matched, `kappa` is Cohen's kappa over the same pairs. Never calls the engine: the budget is zero and nothing asks under this caller.
judge-calibration.ground_truth_note: No engine question: these are bars on a judge's measured agreement with principal-attested labels, not cuts on an engine answer.

lane-train.note: Registry home of the learned router's hand-off cut (LIFEOS/ROUTER/LaneTrain.ts handoffThreshold, moved out of code 2026-10-12): the lane head hands work off only when its P(hand-off) reaches `handoff`. LaneTrain cross-validates at this cut and stamps it into lane-model.json as handoff_threshold, which FrontDoor applies. Never calls the engine: the budget is zero; the refit asks under thinking-train.
lane-train.ground_truth_note: No engine question: the cut applies to the trained lane head's probability; gold is the three-labeler majority LaneTrain scores against.
